mapper.select: SELECT session_id AS sessionId, summary, through_message_id AS throughMessageId, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM chat_session_summary WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_session_summary (session_id, summary, through_message_id) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{summary}, #{throughMessageId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE summary = IF(through_message_id < #{throughMessageId}, #{summary}, summary), through_message_id = IF(through_message_id < #{throughMessageId}, #{throughMessageId}, through_message_id)
